sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 80. Heals HP.
Healing Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Removes all debuffs when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000
